_about: Compile calls of the deep replay (replay_deep/<project>/<vuln>/calls.json) whose recorded command fails in the real build, replaced by the exploit's own fallback compile, which is what ran in the dataset (the replay's compiler recorder always succeeds, so the fallback branch never ran there). Read by deep_recipe.py; the glob of the fallback line is expanded from the image's /opt/src_snapshot.tar.

0.why: the first compile (inflate.c adler32.c zutil.c only) fails to link: undefined reference to `crc32' (verification/results.jsonl); exploit.sh then runs this fallback (`if [ $? -ne 0 ]`)
